name: ship-pilot
description: PR band for the current branch (checks, mergeable, behind main) with the /ship merge-gate replies as buttons, a plan progress bar from the active plan's Atomic Sub-tasks (/progress; click the plan chip or press p for the plan panel), and /check N to tick a sub-task from the phone.

pollSeconds.title: PR poll (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask gh about the branch's PR and checks (0 = only on /pr and after each turn).

pushUrl.title: Phone push URL
pushUrl.description: Optional ntfy-style URL to POST "checks green/failed" to (empty = off).
